question: In 2021 US intelligence reviewed 144 military reports of unidentified objects from 2004 onwards. How many could it explain with confidence?
answer: One: a large, deflating balloon. For nearly all the rest the report said the data were too thin to decide, often a few seconds of sensor footage. Unidentified described how little had been recorded, not what the objects were.
move: Unexplained usually means too little was recorded, not that nothing could explain it.
ask: When something in my life seems mysterious, do I have enough information to call it a mystery?
trap: Nearly all, since most sightings end up having ordinary causes.
reference: Office of the Director of National Intelligence, Preliminary Assessment: Unidentified Aerial Phenomena, 2021
